description: Get a Nomads.com member's own favorite cities and countries (the places they hearted: places they want to go or come back to). Authenticated as the member: signed in through the connector (OAuth sign-in or an Authorization header) if set up, otherwise pass the member's username and their personal key from https://nomads.com/settings - this is private data, not for looking up other people.

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: get_favorites
